h: Ntel reportedly returns to the Nigerian market with cheaper internet plans and eSIM
p: Telecom operator Ntel is reportedly back in Nigeria with lower-priced internet bundles and eSIM support. The company is said to be targeting price-sensitive subscribers as data costs remain a concern. Details of its coverage have not been confirmed.
more: Ntel earlier served only a few major cities.
The relaunch comes as other operators also push eSIM.
